# Sanu Khan — Solution Architect & Platform Engineer

> Solution Architect and Platform Engineering Leader based in Dubai, UAE with 13+ years designing enterprise integrations, distributed platforms, and cloud systems across retail, airline, automotive, and SaaS environments.

## Core Information

- [About Sanu Khan](https://www.sanukhan.dev/about): Architectural philosophy, leadership background, and career trajectory.
- [Selected Work & Case Studies](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects): Detailed case studies on high-throughput distributed systems.
- [Enterprise Retail Integration](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/enterprise-retail-integration): Multi-market PIM and ERP integration architecture.
- [Airline NDC Retailing Aggregation](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/airline-retailing-aggregation): Multi-supplier flight booking and NDC retailing platform.
- [Automotive Omnichannel Platform](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/automotive-omnichannel-platform): Event-driven inventory and lead orchestration system.
- [Real Estate ERP Architecture](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/real-estate-erp-architecture): Distributed property lifecycle and accounting platform.
- [Headless Healthcare Digital Experience](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/headless-healthcare-digital-experience): Unified patient portal and telehealth integration.
- [Garage Management & Diagnostics](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/garage-management-and-diagnostics): Real-time fleet diagnostics and workshop workflow platform.
- [Technical Blog](https://www.sanukhan.dev/blog): Deep-dives into system design, Node.js API best practices, and distributed systems.
- [Contact](https://www.sanukhan.dev/contact): Direct contact channels, email (hello@sanukhan.dev), and professional inquiries.

## Technical Capabilities

- **Architecture:** Solution Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Microservices, API Gateways, Cloud Migrations.
- **Platforms & Clouds:** Microsoft Azure, Node.js, TypeScript, Kafka, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, React.
- **AI & Innovation:** ZaakiyV3RSE agent orchestration, semantic context engines, Model Context Protocol (MCP).
